description.correction: Public SEPTA API providing Regional Rail arrivals and train positions, bus and trolley vehicle locations, alerts and detours, plus Regional Rail and bus/trolley schedule and static data.

notes: Current official Swagger documentation is hosted at api.septa.org and declares /api as its base. The supplied www3 URLs returned 403, while current official search results identify the new host. The documentation describes Regional Rail, bus, and trolley APIs, not subway/elevated real-time coverage. No authoritative API pricing, quota, authentication, or CORS statement was found.
